FORM.notes: source note: IU 1 沒有音檔

S.TRANSL: "(One) goes to pick bamboo shoots, returns, and peels the skin off."

S.FORM: taleken aroma' pal'apehen sipahila aroma' ma pilosnawen.
S.PHON: taləkən aromaʔ palʔapəhən [s|θ]ipahila aromaʔ ma pilo[s|θ]nawən
S.FORM: taleken aroma' pal'apehen sipahila aroma' ma pilosnawen.
S.PHON: taləkən aromaʔ palʔapəhən [s|θ]ipahila aromaʔ ma pilo[s|θ]nawən
S.TRANSL: 有一些曬乾,一些煮一煮(加熱).

S.FORM: taleken aroma' ma hangraen ma' kayzaeh.
S.PHON: taləkən aromaʔ ma haŋræn maʔ kaj[z|ð]æh
S.FORM: taleken aroma' ma hangraen ma' kayzaeh.
S.PHON: taləkən aromaʔ ma haŋræn maʔ kaj[z|ð]æh
S.TRANSL: "(After they are) dried, It is good to fry some too."

S.FORM: So pal pal'apehen sipahila So koSa kapahila 'aewhay ka kawaS intimoen sowiti' mwai' kayzaeh 'okik book.
S.PHON: ʃo pal palʔapəhən [s|θ]ipahila ʃo koʃa kapahila ʔæwhaj ka kawaʃ intimœn [s|θ]owitiʔ mwaiʔ kaj[z|ð]æh ʔokik βook
S.FORM: So pal pal'apehen sipahila So koSa kapahila 'aewhay ka kawaS intimoen sowiti' mwai' kayzaeh 'okik book.
S.PHON: ʃo pal palʔapəhən [s|θ]ipahila ʃo koʃa kapahila ʔæwhaj ka kawaʃ intimœn [s|θ]owitiʔ mwaiʔ kaj[z|ð]æh ʔokik βook
S.TRANSL: 如果天氣好就曬乾.天氣不好就用一點鹽醃,這樣(竹筍)就不會腐爛壞掉.
"If the bamboo is dried when the weather is not good (not sunny), (it is advisable) to salten them a bit so they will not rot."

S.FORM: haysani' 'alikaeh sowiti' ma' isaa So taleken ila kayzaeh ila mari'in taboeon ray hobos.
S.PHON: haj[s|θ]aniʔ ʔalikæh [s|θ]owitiʔ maʔ i[s|θ]aa ʃo taləkən ila kaj[z|ð]æh ila mariʔin taβœon raj hoβo[s|θ]
S.FORM: haysani' 'alikaeh sowiti' ma' isaa So taleken ila kayzaeh ila mari'in taboeon ray hobos.
S.PHON: haj[s|θ]aniʔ ʔalikæh [s|θ]owitiʔ maʔ i[s|θ]aa ʃo taləkən ila kaj[z|ð]æh ila mariʔin taβœon raj hoβo[s|θ]
S.TRANSL: 煮過的竹筍就裝在袋子裡.
"The bamboo shoots are heated and put in a container."

S.FORM: noka bato' kopiyaken kopiyak sipanpanibih kayzaeh 'alikah ka ralom raiw.
S.PHON: noka βatoʔ kopijakən kopijak [s|θ]ipanpaniβih kaj[z|ð]æh ʔalikah ka ralom raiw
S.FORM: noka bato' kopiyaken kopiyak sipanpanibih kayzaeh 'alikah ka ralom raiw.
S.PHON: noka βatoʔ kopijakən kopijak [s|θ]ipanpaniβih kaj[z|ð]æh ʔalikah ka ralom raiw
S.TRANSL: 用石頭壓,重複翻面,讓水分跑出來.
"They are turned around repeatedly using a stone to press water away."

S.FORM: mwai' min'itol 'aehae' hahila ma sipahila hayzaeh ka hahila 'aehae' ila So 'aboe' ka hahila 'aehae' ila ma 'ae'aeiw ila.
S.PHON: mwaiʔ minʔitol ʔæhæʔ hahila ma [s|θ]ipahila haj[z|ð]æh ka hahila ʔæhæʔ ila ʃo ʔaβœʔ ka hahila ʔæhæʔ ila ma ʔæʔæiw ila
S.FORM: mwai' min'itol 'aehae' hahila ma sipahila hayzaeh ka hahila 'aehae' ila So 'aboe' ka hahila 'aehae' ila ma 'ae'aeiw ila.
S.PHON: mwaiʔ minʔitol ʔæhæʔ hahila ma [s|θ]ipahila haj[z|ð]æh ka hahila ʔæhæʔ ila ʃo ʔaβœʔ ka hahila ʔæhæʔ ila ma ʔæʔæiw ila
S.TRANSL: 還有另一個方式,就是第二天當太陽昇起,可以把竹筍曬乾.
"There is another way, which is, the next day when the sun is up, one can go and dry up the bamboo shoots."
